occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The following safety hazards were observed:   * The home has chickens and ducks. The chicken coops must be made inaccessible to the children who will be in care.   *There were several extension cords accessible to children. They must be made in accessible.   *There was a grill and burn barrel that is accessible to the children who will be in care.   *A play structure in the backyard was observed to be unsafe. It was easily shaken and the wood on the structure was not stable.   A follow up inspection was conducted. The hose and extension cords have been removed.   The grill has been covered and the burn barrel moved.   The play structure has been removed.   The chicken coop  has been made made inaccessible. The coop where the ducks are located was not made inaccessbile.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Equipment - Trampolines: A trampoline was observed in the backyard. This must be made inaccessible to the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Equipment - Trampolines (26 TAC §747.4403(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Animals: The home has animals. This information must be located in the  operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Animals (26 TAC §747.501(7))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded: The air conditioner condenser was accessible to the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Air Conditioners, Fans, Heaters Safeguarded (26 TAC §747.3501(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policies were lacking information related to the promotion of physical activity.
